description: Ordinary Talk lines scoped to the existing npc-reaction-profiles.json personality family assignments or to a single named NPC. The authored character's eligible lines take precedence over their family; specific quest/relationship dialogue remains in the NPC database. IDs are stable per owner for save history.

neighborly.label: Checking in
neighborly.text: Good to see you out and about. How's your day treating you?

neighborly.label: Rainy day
neighborly.text: Rain's doing the land some good, at least.

neighborly.label: Returning friend
neighborly.text: There you are! I was wondering how you'd been.

playful.label: A little joke
playful.text: You look like you're carrying a serious thought. Want me to knock it loose?

playful.label: Rain joke
playful.text: Careful—if it rains much harder, we'll all be swimming to breakfast.

playful.label: Familiar face
playful.text: Ha! There's a face I was hoping to see.

reserved.label: Quiet greeting
reserved.text: Oh. Hello. I hope things are going well.

reserved.label: Watching the rain
reserved.text: I like it when the rain makes everything a little quieter.

reserved.label: Quiet welcome
reserved.text: It's nice to see you again.

proper.label: Rain observation
proper.text: Do mind the wet ground. It's easy to lose one's footing.

proper.label: Courteous welcome
proper.text: A pleasure to speak with you again.

stern.label: Brief greeting
stern.text: Keep your eyes open. You never know what's around the next bend.

stern.label: Storm warning
stern.text: This is no weather to be wandering in without a reason.

child.label: Quick hello
child.text: Hi! What have you been doing?

child.label: Rainy day
child.text: I bet the puddles are huge today!

pahu.label: Pahu's wind
pahu.text: Now that's a fine wind! Makes me want to find a sail.

garanki_gabu.label: Garanki's observation
garanki_gabu.text: An ordinary stone can tell quite a story, if you know where to look.

spearhead_unumanuk.label: Spearhead's vigilance
spearhead_unumanuk.text: Keep your guard up, even when the road looks clear.
